verses.text: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.

footnotes.text: Psalm 75 Don't Destroy: See the note at Psalm 57.

verses.text: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
Our LORD and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.

footnotes.text: a cup … wine: In the Old Testament “a cup filled with wine” sometimes stands for God's anger.

verses.text: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
